author: Jake Schincariol
adaptations: Text-only OMP workflow using native task delegation; no executable upstream code or dependencies installed.
Explicit natural-language opt-in; dissatisfaction and installation discussion do not activate it.

Five user-requested approach priorities by default: simplest, resource-optimal, readable, fast/elegant, experimental; fewer on explicit request. Maximum four concurrent workers, one critique phase, main-agent evidence-based synthesis.
No tournament, automatic retries, replacement judges, numeric scoring, or permission changes.
Comparison workers do not edit production files or run checks; existing execution and team policies remain authoritative.
Incomplete worker results remain incomplete comparisons; unsupported judgments are not verified memories.
